about_the_game:
Overview

Frantic Birdies is a fast paced resource collecting survival game where your goal is to hatch as many birds as possible, help them survive and bank as many jewels as you can.

Collect

With your bird you gather worms for food, twigs to build a nest and use the energy from the worms to lay and hatch an egg to hatch a chick. You can then feed the chick worms so they are fully grown. You can then control that new bird.

Collect jewels that come out when you feed a chick and bank them in the tree bank to add to your money score.

Fast-paced

The game gets harder as you try to keep each bird alive whilst collecting resources, creating new bird life and collecting jewels.

You need to avoid the bad birds with your birds as they can send your bird crashing and lose the game.

Controls

The birds can be controlled with the Keyboard or Xbox Controller (untested on other gamepads)

Each bird you can control individually, they also fly by themselves when your not controlling them.

Highscore

Hatch lots of new birds to beat your birds grown high score. Collect more jewels and bank them in the tree bank to beat your money high score.

Key Features

  • Control each bird individually

  • You can level up your bird so they get more value from the jewels they collect.

  • The birds each have a random color as they are created.

  • Each bird has its own money wallet. Go to the bank tree to deposit the birds money and add it to your score.

  • You have to manage each bird's resources such as turning twigs into nests, food into eggs and food into bird feed to feed the chicks.

  • Pixel art style graphics.

  • Beat your high score for birds grown and amount of jewels you collect and bank.
